quests.title: The Bishop's Curse
quests.summary: Read the Cursing Stone of 1525 and find out what an Armstrong thinks of it.

steps.text: Read the Cursing Stone in the yard by Carlisle Castle.
Face the Armstrong of Gilnockie on the cross street.
Tell Curator Bell at Tullie House.

quests.reward: A Reiver's Bonnet and standing with England.

quests.title: Bruce's Heart
quests.summary: Find the bagpiping pig and speak to the Black Douglas, for the heart of Robert the Bruce.

steps.text: Find the bagpipe-playing pig on the roof of Melrose Abbey.
Face the Black Douglas in the abbey.

quests.reward: The Heart of the Bruce charm and standing with Scotland.

quests.title: Ride the Common Riding
quests.summary: Carry the Cornet's colours round the three marches of the town.

steps.text: Fetch the Cornet's colours from Ma Haig's Bakehouse.
Ride the first march at Scott's View.
Ride the second march at the Tweed ford.
Ride the third march at the Eildon Gate, and beat the rival rider.
Return the colours to the Cornet.

quests.reward: The Cornet's Sash charm and standing with Scotland.

quests.title: True Thomas
quests.summary: Meet the Rhymer under the Eildon Tree and win the trust of the Queen of Elfland's white steed.

steps.text: Hear Thomas's story beneath the Eildon Hills.
Catch the elfin steed at the Eildon Tree.
Tell Thomas the steed has come to you.

quests.reward: A Tweed Swatch and standing with Scotland.
